budget: 1 globalMOO model, 1 project, its DOE, then the 8-goal battery as queries on the same trial (max 40 iterations each). No other globalMOO runs for this neuron.
hypothesis: The pole has one main job, 'nerve(s)' as psychological strain or composure, with a weaker anatomical offshoot and a possible 'strength/fortitude' offshoot (the token 'strong'). It is the + end of a context-resolved psychological-vs-physical axis for 'nerve'.

predictions.level_25/50/75: Hit within ±0.05 of target. Passages chosen for higher targets carry the refined sense (dose 1.0); lower targets may use offshoots.
predictions.max: Reaches ~0.9–1.1 of corpus max with a psychological-sense passage after neutral context.
predictions.leak: The only way to fire ≥0.3 with no nerve-related text is the 'strong' branch (~0.4). Nothing else in the bank.
predictions.offshoot: Satisfiable through anatomical 'nerve' in a non-initial position (~0.3).
predictions.silent_on_concept: Satisfiable by preceding a psychological-sense sentence with physical-pain context (sense flip).
predictions.near_miss_ceiling: Driven by morpheme-bearing sentences rated ≤ 0.6 (e.g. the Korean 신경 'nerve energy' line), not by meaning-only near misses.
predictions.efficiency: globalMOO needs fewer model evaluations per goal than differential_evolution (624 per goal) once the DOE is paid.
